description:
Dear community members,

You are invited to join us for the **Annual Community Clean‑Up Day** on **2024-09-14**. The event will run from **2024-09-14T09:00:00-04:00** to **2024-09-14T13:30:00-04:00** and will be held at **Riverfront Park, Main Street Entrance, Springfield**. Volunteers gather to clean up litter, plant trees, and improve the riverfront area. Refreshments and safety gear will be provided.
